svg.title: A straight line and a squiggle on the training books
svg.desc: Two panels of price against pages with the true curve dashed and eight training books as dots. Left: the straight line fitted to the training books, squared errors 4.73. Right: the squiggle through every training book, squared errors 0.00; between 320 and 400 pages it leaves the chart and peaks at 45.6.

g.text: price in hundreds of rupees · dashed curve: the true price · dotted lines: each book's error
